description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamSequenceToken' representing a stream sequence number/token, along with utility methods for comparing such tokens. It is part of the Orleans streaming infrastructure, providing mechanisms for stream subscription starting points and token comparison.

classes.name: StreamSequenceToken
classes.description: An abstract class representing a stream sequence number/token, with properties for sequence number and event index, and methods for equality and comparison.

classes.name: StreamSequenceTokenUtilities
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods to compare StreamSequenceToken instances, such as determining if one token is newer or older than another.

methods.name: Newer
methods.description: Returns true if the first token is newer than the second token.

methods.name: Older
methods.description: Returns true if the first token is older than the second token.
